title: Priority matrix for customer data residency and questionnaire response workflow
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers request a variety of compliance artifacts (SOC2 reports, ISO attestations, DPAs, HIPAA addenda) and vendor questionnaire responses under differing SLAs and data residency constraints. Current intake is manual, causing slow turnaround, missed SLA commitments for high-value accounts, and inconsistent evidence collection across teams.

Goal: Build a prioritized, SLA-weighted intake and response workflow that: 1) automatically classifies incoming compliance asks by regulation (SOC2/ISO/GDPR/HIPAA/DPA) and urgency; 2) applies a priority multiplier based on customer contract tier, data residency requirements, and legal/regulatory windows; 3) surfaces a single source-of-truth evidence pack (Confluence + Drive links) and pre-populates questionnaire answers where possible; and 4) routes tasks to the right team (security, legal, solutions engineering) with expected SLA deadlines and escalation rules.
acceptance_criteria: Automatic classifier tags incoming compliance requests with regulation, urgency, and residency flags with >=90% accuracy on held-out sample
Priority score computed as weighted sum of contract tier, residency risk, and questionnaire complexity and shown on Linear ticket
Evidence-collector creates a draft evidence pack (Confluence page + Drive folder) with at least 50% of frequently requested answers pre-populated from a canonical FAQ store
SLA calendar and escalation rules are attached to the ticket and an automated Slack notification is sent to the assigned queue when SLA breach risk > 48 hours
Dashboard shows time-to-first-response and time-to-complete broken down by regulation and residency region
Playbook documented in Confluence and linked from ticket template; PM/Legal/Security sign-off obtained
tasks: Design priority scoring model (weights for contract tier, residency, questionnaire length, customer revenue) - PM lead
Prototype classifier (text + metadata) and validate against historical tickets - Eng
Implement evidence-harvester bot to scaffold Confluence/Drive evidence packs - Eng / Docs
Create Linear ticket template with computed priority and SLA fields - PM
Define escalation rules and Slack notification templates - Security Ops
Run pilot with top 10 enterprise customers and collect feedback - Solutions Engineering / CSM
Measure pilot metrics and iterate on weighting/sharing logic - PM/Analytics

risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Classifier mis-tags regulation leading to incorrect routing. Mitigation: conservative threshold for automated routing; require human-in-the-loop for low-confidence predictions

Risk: Evidence pack contains stale/incorrect artifacts. Mitigation: evidence-harvester marks auto-sourced answers with source + last-updated timestamp and requires reviewer sign-off before sending to customer
Risk: Residency/legal nuance per customer. Mitigation: add manual override on Linear ticket and require Legal sign-off for cross-border cases with high priority
rollout_plan: Week 1-3: Build classifier and evidence-harvester; internal QA with Security/Legal
Week 4: Pilot with 10 enterprise customers (CSM-coordinated). Monitor SLAs and reviewer feedback.
Week 5-6: Iterate on weighting and FAQ coverage; expand pilot to 30 customers
Week 7: Full rollout to enterprise intake with dashboards and post-launch retrospective
notes: This ticket intentionally separates priority computation from SLA wiring so we can A/B different weightings in pilot.
Consider aligning priority weights with Dedicated contract tiers in dedicated-capacity billing so SLA promises reflect revenue commitments.
Legal requested a retention policy for evidence artifacts; follow-up ticket may be required (PM-51809).
